@@U03003@@
And what pair of lovers
did you lock in your chimney?

@@U03005@@
O God help me, no!
That’s so out of fashion! A farce!
The tender point from which life sprang,
the subtle, thrusting inward force that
took and gave to make itself,
assimilating like and unlike,
is now discredited.
The beast will always find its pleasure there,
but man, whose gifts are greater,
greater! must find a higher, nobler origin.

@@U03006@@
(Turning to the furnace.)

@@U03007@@
Look there! How it gleams!
Let us now hope for the possible!
I make a mixture from many hundred substances—
it’s always the mixture that counts—and, mixing,
leisurely compound the human substance,
seal it in an alembic and cohobate it thoroughly,
and the Work, the Great Work,
will in secret have been accomplished.

@@U03008@@
(Turning again to the furnace.)

@@U03009@@
It’s happening!
The moving mass is clearing itself.
I’m surer now, more than ever!
What once was Nature’s deepest mystery,
we now accomplish boldly with intelligence.
What once Nature accomplished organically,
we will achieve by crystallization!

@@U03011@@
Live long and learn a lot
translation:
@@U03003@@
又是怎样的一对恋人
你锁住你的烟囱了吗？

@@U03005@@
上帝啊帮助我，不！
这太不时尚了！一场闹剧！
生命起源的温柔点，
微妙的、向内推进的力量
索取并给予来创造自己，
同化相似和不同，
现在已经名誉扫地了。
野兽总能在那里找到快乐，
但人类的天赋更伟大，
更大！必须找到更高、更高贵的出身。

@@U03006@@
（转向炉子。）

@@U03007@@
看那儿！它多么闪闪发光啊！
现在让我们希望有可能！
我用数百种物质制成混合物——
重要的始终是混合物——并且，混合，
悠闲地合成人体物质，
将其密封在蒸馏器中并彻底混合，
以及工作，伟大的工作，
将会秘密地完成。

@@U03008@@
（再次转向炉子。）

@@U03009@@
它正在发生！
移动的物体正在自行清理。
我现在比以往任何时候都更加确定！
曾经是大自然最深奥的谜团，
我们现在用智慧大胆地完成任务。
大自然曾经有机地完成的事情，
我们将成就结晶！

@@U03011@@
活得长久，学到很多东西
